battle.name: 蘇聯入侵阿富汗
battle.theater: 喀布爾盆地與興都庫什山區
battle.brief: 一九七九年十二月二十四日，蘇聯空降兵奇襲巴格蘭機場，攻入喀布爾，扶植新政府；九年零兩個月之後，最後一批T-62坦克駛過阿姆河回國。卡面這輛一九六一年列裝的主戰坦克，是蘇軍摩步師坦克團的標準配備，在帕尼什河谷與薩朗山口的攻防裡，擔負正面突破與近距離火力支援的角色。

kit.name: T-62主戰坦克
kit.history: T-62是蘇聯陸軍裝甲部隊的主戰坦克，部署於坦克部隊，負責正面突破、機動作戰與近距離火力支援，並配合步兵作戰。

countries: 交戰的一方是蘇聯武裝力量與其扶植的阿富汗人民民主黨政府。蘇聯自一九七九年十二月起在阿富汗境內組建所謂的「有限部隊」，先以空降兵第100師、第8近衛空降師、第104近衛空降師為骨幹，配合第15摩步師等摩托化部隊，由設在土耳其斯坦的第40軍司令部統一調度，進駐巴格蘭、喀布爾、坎大哈、賈拉勒阿巴德與赫拉特等地；一九八一年正式改編為第40集團軍，元帥阿赫羅梅耶夫出任司令，末期由格羅莫夫接掌，轄下五個摩步師、數個空降旅與炮兵旅。另一方是以「伊斯蘭陣線」為核心的阿富汗游擊隊，由赫克馬提亞爾、賽義夫、馬蘇德等分區割據，在白沙瓦以「白沙瓦七人組」協調，並有數萬名經巴基斯坦湧入的阿拉伯志願者。阿富汗政府軍與內政部秘密警察（KHAD）在蘇聯軍事顧問指導下運作，雙方之間亦長期互相猜忌蘇聯的真正目標。
countriesEn: One side of the conflict was the Soviet armed forces together with the Afghan government of the People's Democratic Party that they had installed. From December 1979 Moscow built a so-called limited contingent inside Afghanistan: the 100th Airborne Division, the 8th Guards Airborne Division and the 104th Guards Airborne Division, supported by motor rifle and tank units such as the 15th Motor Rifle Division, all under the headquarters of the 40th Army in Termez, took Bagram, Kabul, Kandahar, Jalalabad and Herat. In 1981 the formation was expanded into the 40th Army, commanded at first by Marshal Akhromeyev and in the final years by General Gromov, with five motor rifle divisions, several airborne brigades and artillery brigades under it. The other side was the Afghan mujahideen organised around the Islamic Front, divided among strongmen such as Hekmatyar, Sayyaf and Massoud, coordinated in Peshawar by the so-called Peshawar Seven, and reinforced by tens of thousands of Arab volunteers who entered the country through Pakistan. The Afghan government army and the KHAD secret police of the Interior Ministry operated under Soviet military advisers, and the two sides remained deeply suspicious of each other about what Moscow's real purpose was.
people: 阿富汗方面，總統哈菲佐拉·阿明在人民民主黨內部鬥爭中上位，卻逐步疏遠莫斯科而靠攏美國，一九七九年十二月二十七日被蘇軍帶入總統宮，二十八日身亡，與家人同命。巴巴拉克·卡爾邁爾先後出任總理與國家元首，一九八四年被穆罕默德·納吉布拉取代；納吉布拉任內以蘇聯空軍與炮兵支撐的戰略防禦應對游擊隊，一九八七年召開大支里加推行政治改革，並暗中尋求撤軍；一九八六年情報總頭目阿卜杜勒·拉齊克遇刺，說明宮內爭鬥激烈。抵抗陣線方面，赫克馬提亞爾掌控首都東北的勢力，賽義夫在白沙瓦的軍火市場居中，馬蘇德於一九八〇年四月在帕尼什河谷集結數十人，漸成抗蘇骨幹。蘇聯一側，勃列日涅夫拍板出兵，安德羅波夫以駐外大使身分抵喀布爾促成行動，阿赫羅梅耶夫、格羅莫夫先後統兵；美方則有中情局阿富汗特遣組、巴基斯坦情報局與總統齊亞的角色，一九八八年由古斯塔夫·阿夫拉科托斯與多布羅寧在日內瓦談成撤軍協議。
peopleEn: On the Afghan side President Hafizullah Amin had risen to the top of the People's Democratic Party but had steadily distanced himself from Moscow and moved towards the United States; on 27 December 1979 he was taken by Soviet troops into the presidential palace and killed the next day together with his family. Babrak Karmal served first as head of government and then as head of state before being replaced in 1984 by Muhammad Najibullah, who during his term relied on Soviet air and artillery support in a strategic defensive posture, convened a loya jirga in 1987 to promote political reform, and quietly explored a Soviet withdrawal; the assassination of intelligence chief Abdul Raziq in 1986 showed how bitter the struggles inside the palace had become. On the resistance side Hekmatyar controlled the approaches to the capital from the north-east, Sayyaf presided over the arms market in Peshawar, and Massoud raised several dozen men in the Panjshir valley in April 1980 and gradually became the backbone of the anti-Soviet struggle. On the Soviet side Brezhnev authorised the intervention, Andropov returned to Kabul as ambassador to see it through, and Akhromeyev and Gromov commanded the troops in turn. For the Americans the roles were played by the CIA's Afghan task force, Pakistan's ISI and President Zia; in 1988 Gust Avrakotos and Anatoly Dobrynin negotiated the Geneva Accords.
kits: 卡面這輛T-62主戰坦克是一九六一年列裝的蘇聯中型坦克，戰鬥全重約三十六噸，乘員五人，裝V-46-6柴油機，公路極速約五十公里，續航約四百五十公里，主砲為115毫米D-25T線膛砲，標準型備彈四十五發，加裝自動裝填機的改進型可增至八十發。在阿富汗，T-62是蘇軍裝甲部隊的骨幹：每個摩步師轄一個坦克團，空降師與坦克師同樣配屬T-62與T-55，另有數量不多的T-72。當地條件對它既苛刻又殘酷：喀布爾海拔一千七百九十米，薩朗山口三千四百米，高原使柴油機功率下降；沙塵極重，空濾與履帶保養是每日例行功課；重逾三十噸的車體無法通過多數鄉間便道，橋樑承重亦成限制，因此蘇軍進攻多沿一號公路與城市外圍推進。游擊隊同樣大量使用蘇制武器：AK-47步槍、PKM通用機槍、DShK重機槍、RPG-7火箭筒、AT-3「薩格」反裝甲導彈，還有大量地雷與自製炸藥。空軍配Mi-8與Mi-17運輸直升機、Mi-24武裝直升機，一九八五年起投入Su-25對地攻擊機；炮兵有122與152毫米自行火砲及BM-21「冰雹」火箭炮。一九八六年美方交付的FIM-43「毒刺」便攜防空導彈成為扭轉空優的關鍵裝備，而TOW導彈因T-62使用線膛砲，須加裝測距適配器，命中率大打折扣。
kitsEn: The T-62 main battle tank shown on the card is a Soviet medium tank that entered service in 1961. It weighs about thirty-six tonnes in combat order, carries a crew of five, and is powered by the V-46-6 diesel engine for a road speed near fifty kilometres per hour and a range of roughly four hundred and fifty kilometres. Its main armament is the 115 mm D-25T rifled gun; the standard version carries forty-five rounds, rising to about eighty on models fitted with an automatic loader. In Afghanistan the T-62 was the backbone of Soviet armour: every motor rifle division had a tank regiment equipped with it, and the airborne divisions and tank divisions drew on T-62s and T-55s, with smaller numbers of T-72s. Local conditions were as harsh on the tank as on the crews: Kabul stands at 1,790 metres and the Salang Pass at 3,400, and thin air cut diesel output; dust was so heavy that air filters and track maintenance became daily work; a vehicle of more than thirty tonnes could not pass along most country tracks, and bridge loading became a limit as well, so Soviet advances ran along the main trunk road and around the edges of towns. The mujahideen used Soviet weapons on the same scale: AK-47 rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, DShK heavy machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, Sagger anti-tank guided missiles, and a great many mines and improvised charges. On the air side flew Mi-8 and Mi-17 transports, Mi-24 gunships and, from 1985, Su-25 ground attack aircraft; the artillery included 122 mm and 152 mm self-propelled guns and BM-21 Grad rocket launchers. The FIM-43 Stinger delivered by the United States from 1986 became the key air defence weapon, while TOW missiles had to be fitted with a probe adapter because the T-62 carried a rifled barrel, which cut their effectiveness sharply.
tactics: 蘇軍的戰術沿一條軸線展開：先以空降兵奇襲奪取巴格蘭與坎大哈機場，確保空運與技術支援落地，再由摩步師沿公路推進，逐點建立據點，以小分隊巡邏封鎖山谷，蘇軍稱之為「茶壺」；坦克團在步兵掩護下沿公路與河谷突進，遇游擊隊即停下，展開炮兵與空軍支援，待殲滅對手再向前滾動。補給依賴自土耳其斯坦捷列梅茲、海拉坦到喀布爾的一千三百餘公里公路車隊，車隊常遭伏擊，護衛、掃雷與空中巡邏成常態，游擊隊則以小組襲擊、撤入山村、反覆游擊三種方式應對。一九八八年五月發動的「大幹線」行動，企圖以重兵奪回薩朗山口與賈拉勒阿巴德、切斷白沙瓦至喀布爾的走廊，是蘇軍最大規模的攻勢，但因游擊隊退入帕尼什河谷而未能殲滅對手。蘇聯亦以MiG機與武裝直升機先行火力準備，再用空投部隊與突擊群攻佔山頭。游擊戰一方則以連續襲擊與撤退拖住蘇軍，把戰爭變成補給與士氣的消耗戰；一九八八年五月馬蘇德的部隊奪下塔利坎，是開戰以來游擊隊首次控制較大的城市。
tacticsEn: Soviet operations unfolded along a single axis: airborne troops struck by surprise to seize the airfields at Bagram and Kandahar so that airlift and technical support could land, then motor rifle divisions advanced along the roads, establishing strongpoints one by one and patrolling with small units to seal the valleys, a practice the Soviets called a kettle. Tank regiments pushed forward with infantry in support along roads and river valleys, halted whenever they met the mujahideen, brought up artillery and air support, and then rolled on once the enemy was destroyed. Supply depended on convoys of more than thirteen hundred kilometres along the road from Termez via Hairatan to Kabul; convoys were habitually ambushed, and escort, minesweeping and air patrols became routine, while the mujahideen answered with small-group attacks, withdrawal into the mountains and repeated harassment. Operation Magistral, launched in May 1988 to retake the Salang Pass and Jalalabad and cut the Peshawar-Kabul corridor, was the largest Soviet offensive of the war, but it failed to destroy the mujahideen, who withdrew into the Panjshir valley. The Soviets also used MiGs and gunships to prepare the ground, then landed assault groups and airborne units to seize the ridges. The mujahideen countered with continuous attacks and withdrawals that turned the war into a contest of logistics and morale; in May 1988 Massoud's men took Taliqan, the first sizeable town the resistance held since 1979.
data: 自一九七九年十二月二十四日的空降到一九八九年二月十五日最後一批蘇軍過境，歷時九年零兩個月，這是各界最常引用的計法。兵力方面，一九八〇年初蘇軍在阿富汗約四萬人，其後逐年增加，一九八五至一九八八年高峰時各類估計約十萬至十一萬五千人；武裝游擊隊人數則從一九八〇年初的數萬增至後期約五萬至七萬，其中有約三萬至四萬名經巴基斯坦進入的外國志願者。蘇聯當局在戰後公布的陣亡數為一萬五千零五十一名，一九八九年解密後的更完整資料上修至一萬七千九百五十三名，另有約五萬人受傷或患病；西方學界一般認為實際陣亡在一萬至一萬五千之間。游擊隊方面的損失記錄極不完整，阿富汗政府一度宣稱陣亡逾九萬人，但其中相當部分難以核實。損失結構最特殊的一點是交通事故與地雷：學界常引述，蘇軍陣亡者中約有一成至一成半並非戰鬥傷亡，而是死於翻車、觸雷與高海拔事故。全戰線蘇軍坦克總數的各方統計相差極大，專家估計在一千至三千輛之間，其中T-62佔比最大，是每個摩步師坦克團的標準配備。
dataEn: The war is most often measured from the airborne landing of 24 December 1979 to the last Soviet column crossing back on 15 February 1989, a little over nine years. In manpower terms, Soviet strength in Afghanistan stood at roughly forty thousand in early 1980 and rose year by year to a peak variously estimated at one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifteen thousand in 1985 to 1988; armed mujahideen grew from tens of thousands in 1980 to roughly fifty to seventy thousand later on, including some thirty to forty thousand foreign volunteers who entered through Pakistan. The Soviet authorities announced 15,051 dead after the war, a figure revised upwards to 17,953 when fuller records were released in 1989, alongside some fifty thousand wounded or sick; Western scholarship generally puts Soviet dead between ten and fifteen thousand. Records of mujahideen losses are fragmentary, and the Afghan government at one point claimed more than ninety thousand dead, a figure that cannot be verified. The most distinctive feature of the losses is the share caused by accidents and mines: scholars often cite that between one tenth and one eighth of Soviet military deaths were not combat casualties but rollovers, mines and accidents at altitude. Estimates of the total Soviet tank strength across the whole theatre vary enormously, from one thousand to three thousand vehicles, of which the T-62 formed the largest single group as the standard equipment of every motor rifle division tank regiment.
cause: 起因要從阿富汗人民民主黨內部的分裂說起。一九七八年四月的「四月革命」（Saur Revolution）推翻穆罕默德·達烏德，黨內以哈菲佐拉·阿明為首的一派掌權；阿明上台後清洗親蘇的老干部，拒絕蘇聯繼續提供的貸款，又把秘密警察與情報機構交由美國中情局培訓，與巴基斯坦商定美援的處理方式，一九七九年春美方情報更發現蘇軍在中亞與阿富汗邊境集結徵候。同年二月赫拉特、三月法拉茲、四月坎大哈與同年夏秋的賈拉勒阿巴德接連發生武裝起事，首都與北部交通線不斷受襲。蘇聯領導層的判斷是：阿明政權已無挽回希望，抵抗運動一旦成功，鄰近的穆斯林國家會受鼓動，中亞與高加索的加盟共和國也會不安，蘇聯南部與中東方向的中國邊境將暴露。勃列日涅夫於一九七九年十二月在政治局拍板出兵，安德羅波夫以大使身分返抵喀布爾主持最後協調，十二月二十四日空降兵出手，衝突由內戰變成公開的國家對國家戰爭。蘇聯事後的官方說法是「應阿富汗人民民主黨與政府的要求出兵平叛」，這一定位也成為其後十年敘事的基本框架。
causeEn: The origins lie in the internal split of the Afghan People's Democratic Party. The April 1978 revolution, known in Persian as the Saur Revolution, overthrew Mohammed Daoud, and a faction led by Hafizullah Amin took power. Amin purged the pro-Soviet old guard, refused further Soviet loans, handed the secret police and intelligence services over to training by the American CIA, and worked out an arrangement with Pakistan over American aid; in the spring of 1979 United States intelligence detected Soviet troops massing on the Central Asian and Afghan borders. Armed risings followed in quick succession, in Herat in February 1979, Farah in March, Kandahar in April and Jalalabad in the summer and autumn of the same year, while the capital and the northern lines of communication were repeatedly attacked. The Soviet leadership judged that the Amin regime could not be recovered, that the resistance, if it won, would encourage the neighbouring Muslim states, that the Central Asian and Caucasian republics would grow restive, and that the southern flank would be exposed. Brezhnev authorised the intervention at a Politburo meeting in December 1979, Andropov returned to Kabul as ambassador to coordinate the last steps, and the airborne troops moved on 24 December, turning what had been a civil war into an open war between states. Moscow's official account afterwards, that the troops were sent at the request of the Afghan People's Democratic Party and government to suppress the rebellion, became the basic frame of the narrative for the next ten years.
impact: 這場戰爭把冷戰的代理戰模式推到頂點，也把蘇聯推向經濟與道德的雙重透支。對美國而言，這是一九八〇年之後最成功的政策之一：中情局以「旋風」計劃經巴基斯坦輸送武器與資金，一九八六年交付的「毒刺」導彈在數年內改變了空優與補給線的樣貌，美國的戰略信譽在雷根時代得到修復。對蘇聯而言，戰爭的代價是每年數十億盧布的軍費與一條越拉越長的補給線，一九八五年之後更明顯拖累改革與軍備競賽；戈巴契夫上臺後不得不尋求體面退出。有學者認為這場消耗戰是蘇聯解體的重要外因之一。戰爭留下的地緣後果更為長久：一九八九年撤軍並未換來和平，抵抗運動分裂為彼此傾軋的派系，一九九二年納吉布拉政府垮台，內戰全面爆發，一九九六年塔利班掌權；當年流散海外的武裝與經驗，成為其後極端組織擴張的人力與傳承來源。另一層更冷的解讀是：雙方都以為自己在贏，最後誰都沒拿到想要的結局。
impactEn: The war pushed the Cold War proxy model to its extreme and drained the Soviet Union of both money and morale. For the United States it became one of the most successful policies of the period after 1980: the CIA ran Operation Cyclone, funneling weapons and money through Pakistan, and the Stinger missiles handed over in 1986 changed the balance in the air and the shape of the supply lines within a few years, restoring American strategic credibility in the Reagan years. For the Soviet Union the cost was billions of roubles a year and a supply line that grew ever longer, an obvious drag on reform and the arms race after 1985; once Gorbachev came to power he had to look for a dignified exit. Many scholars treat this war of attrition as one of the external causes of Soviet dissolution. The geopolitical consequences have proved even longer-lived: the 1989 withdrawal bought no peace, the resistance split into rival factions, Najibullah's government fell in 1992, civil war broke out in full, and the Taliban took power in 1996; the fighters and the experience dispersed abroad became the manpower and the inheritance of later extremist expansion. There is also a colder reading: each side believed it was winning, and in the end neither got the outcome it wanted.
result: 一九八八年四月十四日的日內瓦協議簽訂，規定蘇軍自同年五月起分批撤出，一九八九年二月十五日前全部完成；協議由阿富汗與巴基斯坦接受，美蘇兩國作保證人，並商定美方於一九八九年二月之後停止向抵抗運動供應武器。撤軍以鐵路與公路聯運分批進行，最後一段由陸軍大將鮑里斯·格羅莫夫率隊，車隊在阿姆河上越過捷列梅茲的大橋，最後一批車輛把香檳灑進河裡告別。蘇軍主力確實離開了，但大批「軍事顧問」留在阿富汗延續指導，這批人數各方說法由數百到數千不等，此後仍與內戰雙方交火。一九八八年五月抵抗派系之間的「白沙瓦協議」未能統合力量，一九九〇年三月的「伊斯堡協議」同樣流於空談；一九九二年四月納吉布拉出走，蘇聯扶植的政權在首都陷落。從軍事看蘇聯是撤退，從政治看是一次承認失敗；從長期看，蘇聯解體與阿富汗內戰的雙重風暴，把這個國家推向三十年的戰火。T-62則留在阿富汗，直到二十一世紀仍有少量在役，更多被繳獲的T-62在內戰各方手中繼續運作。
resultEn: The Geneva Accords of 14 April 1988 provided for the phased withdrawal of Soviet troops beginning that May and for their complete departure by 15 February 1989; Afghanistan and Pakistan accepted them, the United States and the Soviet Union acted as guarantors, and the United States agreed to stop supplying arms to the resistance once February 1989 began. The withdrawal was carried out by rail and road in stages, the last convoy led by Army General Boris Gromov, whose vehicles crossed the bridge over the Amu Darya at Termez and tipped the last of their champagne into the river. The main Soviet force did leave, but a large body of military advisers stayed behind to keep giving guidance, their numbers reported anywhere from several hundred to several thousand, and they went on fighting in the civil war. The Peshawar Accords of May 1988 did not unify the resistance factions, and the Islamabad Accord of March 1990 amounted to nothing; in April 1992 Najibullah fled and the Soviet-backed government fell as Kabul was taken. Militarily the Soviet Union withdrew; politically it conceded defeat; and in the longer run the double shock of Soviet dissolution and Afghan civil war drove the country into three decades of war. The T-62 stayed in Afghanistan, with a few still in service into the twenty-first century, while many captured tanks went on working in the hands of the contending factions.
